scripts.build: npm run build --prefix web && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('web/.next')) { try { fs.cpSync('web/.next', '.next', {recursive:true}); } catch(e){} } if(fs.existsSync('.next') && !fs.existsSync('web/.next')) { try { fs.mkdirSync('web', {recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('.next', 'web/.next', {recursive:true}); } catch(e){} }"
